title: Senior Director, Technology Operations
description:
Job Description:

  

Ready to lead the operations center that stops watching alerts and starts supervising autonomous systems at Thomson Reuters™?

  

At Thomson Reuters, we are transforming Service Management from a reactive, process-bound group into a proactive, intelligence-driven organization, one in which data flows into intelligence, intelligence into orchestration, and orchestration into execution. The Global Command Center (GCC) is where that model is realized: the 24×7 function that sees what is happening across our services, decides what needs to happen next, and makes it happen, increasingly with automation acting first and people handling the exceptions.

We are seeking a Senior Director of Service Operations, based in Bangalore, to lead this transformation. The majority of our operations population already sits in India, and this role puts senior leadership where that scale is. It is a run-side leadership role with a build-side partnership: our AI Operations (AIOps) and Workflow Engineering functions design the intelligence and the workflows, while you own turning those into daily operational practice. Your central mandate is to make L0 real, the tier in which AI and automation resolve issues ahead of human responders, with the GCC operating as L1 for exceptions and L2 reserved for genuine major incidents. Success looks like less toil, fewer escalations, fewer people with “eyes on glass,” and an operation that moves at the speed of the business.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

In this opportunity as Senior Director, Service Operations, you will:

  

* Lead the GCC as a single, consistent 24×7 function covering event triage, service health, operational communications, and real-time response, working through a distributed, multi-shift organization based primarily in India.
* Own the operational adoption of L0, defining the readiness criteria and decision gates under which the GCC allows automation to act ahead of human responders, and expanding that coverage service by service.
* Set and deliver the operational measures that matter, from alert-to-incident ratio and first-touch resolution at L1 to escalation rate, MTTD, MTTR, and auto-resolution rate, with reporting that makes operational posture clear to senior leadership at any moment.
* Move the operation from reactive to proactive, and over time from eyes on glass to on demand, reshaping the shift model, staffing, and skills profile around an exception-driven way of working, so that our engineers spend their time on judgment rather than triage.
* Extend GCC coverage across our products and services with consistent monitoring standards, runbook coverage, and communications, and extend the definition of operational health beyond infrastructure availability to application and customer journey experience.
* Grow the capability of an operations workforce whose role is changing from monitoring alerts to supervising automated systems, and build the leadership bench that will carry that change forward.
Feed operational reality back to AIOps, Workflow Engineering, and Problem Management under a clear build versus run separation, partnering closely with our separately led major incident management and automation engineering functions.  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

  

You’re a fit for the role of Senior Director, Service Operations if your background includes running operations at enterprise scale and changing how they run, not simply keeping them stable. Specifically:

  

* A minimum of 15 years of experience in technology operations, including at least 5 years leading a 24×7 command center, NOC, or global service operations function at enterprise scale. A bachelor’s degree in a technical field is required, with a master’s and relevant certifications (ITIL, ServiceNow, SRE, cloud) preferred.
* Proven experience leading large, distributed operations organizations in India, including leaders of leaders and multi-shift, follow-the-sun models, with a track record of raising consistency and quality across sites and shifts.
* Demonstrated operational adoption of AI and automation, having taken capability built by others and put it into safe, live production use with the guardrails, approval gates, readiness criteria, and rollback discipline that make it trustworthy, with measurable outcomes to point to.
* A track record of reducing toil and escalations by shifting resolution left into first-line teams and cutting alert noise, with the analytical habit of interrogating an escalation trend rather than accepting it.
* Experience taking a monitoring-led operation to an exception-led one, reducing the share of capacity spent on eyes-on-glass surveillance and redesigning shift and staffing models around on-demand engagement, without losing coverage or confidence along the way.
* Strong command of the event and incident lifecycle and the tooling behind it, including ServiceNow ITSM and Event Management, modern observability platforms, and the CMDB and tagging discipline that correlation depends on.
* The rigor to set, instrument, and defend operational targets across availability and SLOs, MTTD and MTTR, auto-resolution rate, and escalation rate, and to use them to change behavior rather than to report on it.
* Credibility and calm with senior stakeholders during major incidents, together with the change-leadership skill to take an established operations organization through a significant shift in how it works, including the people and morale dimensions of that change.
Clarity about the boundary between building and running, so that you are energized by partnering with engineering and AI functions on capability you do not own, and hold your side of that line without needing to widen it.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* A master’s degree in a technical field, or an equivalent advanced qualification.
Certifications such as ITIL, ServiceNow, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or cloud (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).

**Context and scope**
=====================

Global Benefits Operations delivers benefits administration through consistent processes, reliable data, effective controls and responsive employee support. The Assistant Manager leads the assigned team across markets and time zones, translating approved benefit policies into accurate, timely and controlled operational delivery.

The scope includes annual benefit enrolment, joiner, mover and leaver administration, vendor data exchanges, purchase orders, invoice reconciliation, reporting and query management. Benefits may include health insurance, pensions, product allowances, car benefits and other locally approved arrangements, where assigned to the team.

**Purpose of the role**
=======================

Own the day-to-day performance of the assigned benefits operations service, protecting employee benefit continuity and financial accuracy. Build a capable team, resolve operational escalations and improve processes through standardisation, simplification and automation in line with the global payroll and benefits strategy.

**Financial responsibilities**
==============================

  

* Manage benefits purchase order creation, invoice validation and reconciliation within procurement requirements and delegated authority; coordinate timely payment with Finance and Accounts Payable.
* Reconcile vendor charges to approved rates, eligibility and enrolment data. Investigate discrepancies, recover or correct errors and escalate unresolved liabilities before service continuity is affected.
* Monitor assigned operational costs and spend against approved plans; provide variance insights and identify measurable efficiency opportunities.

**Market complexity**
=====================

  

* Lead service delivery across the assigned markets, accommodating local benefit rules, enrolment calendars, currencies, languages, vendor arrangements and time zones.
* Coordinate accurate and timely joiner, mover and leaver data and benefit changes across Workday, benefit platforms, vendors and Payroll. Validate payroll-impacting deductions, allowances and taxable benefit inputs within agreed cut-offs.
* Partner with Reward, market HR, Payroll, Finance, Procurement, Tax and Digital teams to resolve dependencies and clarify ownership at process hand-offs.
* Implement approved policy and regulatory changes with guidance from Reward, HR, Tax and Legal; maintain market-specific procedures and operational evidence.
* Manage sensitive employee data through approved access, transfer and retention controls. Maintain service continuity during peak enrolment, organisational changes and vendor or system transitions.

**Leadership responsibilities and capabilities**
================================================

  

* Lead Benefits Junior Managers and Case Specialists with clear accountabilities, work allocation, performance expectations and escalation routes.
* Plan capacity for routine activity and peak cycles; establish trained backups, maintain knowledge coverage and address capability gaps through coaching and development.
* Review service performance, aged cases, control exceptions and recurring failures. Hold team members and partners accountable for corrective actions and sustained results.
* Make timely operational decisions within delegated authority. Escalate material employee, financial, compliance and service risks with clear impact, options and recommended action.
* Build constructive relationships across functions and vendors; challenge missed commitments and resolve issues through evidence and clear ownership.
* Create an inclusive team environment where colleagues raise concerns early, learn from errors and take responsibility for employee outcomes.
* Deliver improvements with the Process Excellence and Transformation teams, ensuring implementation readiness, control integrity and measurable benefits.

**Decision rights and governance**
==================================

The role owns operational work allocation, quality assurance, service escalations and improvement delivery within the agreed scope. Approvals for expenditure, benefit changes and vendor commitments must follow delegated authority. Reward and market HR retain benefit policy and plan design decisions; Tax and Legal provide specialist interpretation. Vendor governance, including pensions, follows the agreed ownership model for each market.

**Top five accountabilities**
=============================

1. Benefits service delivery and employee experience

  

* Own accurate and timely delivery of assigned benefits administration, reporting, vendor data exchanges and annual enrolment activities against agreed service levels and calendars.
* Manage complex cases and escalations, prioritising employee impact and benefit continuity. Ensure timely updates, clear resolution ownership and follow-through.
* Maintain readiness plans for peak cycles, absence cover and service disruption; resolve upstream dependencies before deadlines are missed.

**2. Financial control compliance and assurance**
-------------------------------------------------

* Ensure assigned CARM controls, reconciliations and quality checks are performed, evidenced and independently reviewed in line with control design.
* Oversee purchase orders, vendor invoices and reconciliation exceptions, maintaining clear audit trails and appropriate segregation of duties.
* Coordinate audit requests and close findings; investigate control failures, implement root-cause actions and escalate material risks promptly.

**3. Vendor and stakeholder management**
----------------------------------------

  

* Manage operational performance of assigned benefits vendors through service reviews, action tracking and escalation of missed commitments.
* Work with Finance, Procurement and vendor owners to resolve billing and payment issues; support renewal and service improvement discussions with performance evidence.
* Agree responsibilities and cut-offs with Reward, HR and Payroll, ensuring unresolved issues have a named owner and escalation route.

**4. Digital enablement and process excellence**
------------------------------------------------

  

* Maintain accurate process maps, work instructions, benefits matrices, guides, factsheets and FAQs; ensure changes are approved, communicated and supported by training.
* Use Workday, benefits platforms and case management tools to improve data quality, reporting and workflow visibility.
* Deliver prioritised standardisation and automation initiatives with relevant partners, validating employee outcomes, controls and realised efficiency.

**5. Team leadership and capability building**
----------------------------------------------

  

* Set individual objectives, review performance and coach the team in benefits administration, financial controls, problem-solving and stakeholder communication.
* Maintain skills assessments, training plans and backup coverage for critical processes; address underperformance with clear expectations and support.
* Embed ownership, respectful challenge and continuous learning; ensure delivery quality is sustained during staffing and scope changes.

**Measures of success**
=======================

Performance will be assessed against agreed annual targets for service accuracy, timeliness and case SLAs; enrolment and benefit continuity; invoice and reconciliation completion; control execution and audit closure; vendor performance; backup coverage; and verified improvement benefits.

**Core skills required**
========================

  

* Benefits operations expertise – understand eligibility, enrolment, lifecycle changes and links to payroll, finance and employee experience.
* People leadership – plan work, coach colleagues, manage performance and build capability and backup coverage.

title: IT, Facilities & Lab Operations Manager
description:
**IT, Facilities & Lab Operations Manager**
===========================================

**Location:** Bengaluru, India | On-site

**Company:** Ayar Labs

**Position Overview**
---------------------

Great engineering depends on a workplace that works: laptops ready on day one, reliable connectivity, an organized lab, and someone nearby who can figure out what’s wrong and get it fixed.

At Ayar Labs, we’re building optical I/O technology for high-performance computing. We’re looking for a resourceful, hands-on IT, Facilities & Lab Operations Manager to support our India office and help our engineers do their best work. You’ll be the local person people turn to for technical help and practical solutions, working closely with the office manager and our global IT and lab teams.

This is an on-site role with plenty of variety. One morning, you might help a colleague get connected, set up a new workstation, or troubleshoot hardware with a remote IT teammate. Later, you might organize a lab bench, check a portable clean dry air (CDA) system, or coordinate a repair with a service provider. You’ll manage day-to-day operations through direct, hands-on work, with room to improve how the site runs as it grows.

**What You’ll Achieve**
-----------------------

  

* **An engineering team that can stay focused.** Provide friendly, responsive helpdesk support for computers, software, accounts, connectivity, and meeting-room technology. Help new colleagues get started, keep users informed, and follow issues through to resolution. Work with global IT on access, device setup, updates, and security practices.
  
* **Reliable cloud support for the EDA team.** Support engineering teams in an AWS environment. Partner with global IT and EDA to help provision and maintain Linux compute environments, manage user access, and troubleshoot connectivity, storage, and tool-license access issues so engineers can keep design and simulation workloads running.
  
* **Local hands for a global team.** Be the on-site eyes and hands for remote IT and engineering colleagues. Help install and connect equipment, inspect hardware, trace and label cables, replace approved components, and carry out guided troubleshooting. Capture useful details so specialists can resolve issues quickly.
  
* **Labs and workspaces that are ready to use.** Keep benches, equipment, tools, spares, and supplies organized and easy to find. Maintain practical inventory and maintenance records, support equipment setup and moves, and coordinate service or calibration with lab owners and vendors. Follow lab safety and equipment-handling procedures, including electrostatic discharge (ESD) precautions where applicable.
  
* **Small facilities problems are handled before they become disruptions.** Partner with the office manager on everyday upkeep, minor repairs, and simple installations. Support routine checks and basic upkeep of portable CDA systems and other supporting equipment within your training and approved procedures. Coordinate with building management and qualified service providers when work needs specialist attention, and follow through until it’s complete.
  
* **Better ways of working.** Turn recurring problems into practical improvements. Keep clear support notes, useful checklists, and straightforward how-to guides. Help plan equipment and supply needs, flag risks early, and coordinate priorities with the office manager, IT, and engineering.

**Skills You’ll Need to Bring**
-------------------------------

  

* **5+ years of IT experience**, with hands-on helpdesk, desktop support, systems administration, or similar work supporting employees directly.
  
* A practical troubleshooting foundation across computer hardware, operating systems, business applications, user access, and basic networking. You can work through an unfamiliar problem and recognize when to bring in a specialist.
  
* Comfort with light facilities work: using basic tools, fixing small problems, helping set up workspaces, and learning the routine care of equipment such as portable CDA systems.
  
* Strong organization skills and a habit of leaving labs, workspaces, equipment records, and shared supplies easier for others to use.
  
* Clear communication, patience with users, and dependable follow-through. You can work independently on-site while coordinating effectively with remote colleagues and local vendors.
  

Experience in a semiconductor, electronics, or photonics lab is a plus. Familiarity with Linux, Windows, lab equipment handling, ESD practices, asset tracking, or small-office facilities support will also help. You don’t need to have done every part of this role already; we’re looking for a solid IT foundation, practical judgment, and an interest in learning the rest.

**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------

You’ll see the impact of your work every day: a new hire ready to contribute, a lab setup back in service, or an engineer able to keep working because you spotted and solved a problem. You’ll work close to the engineering team, build experience across IT and lab operations, and help shape a workplace people can rely on.

If you enjoy helping people, working with your hands, and making things run better, we’d like to hear from you.

**NOTE TO RECRUITERS:** Principals only. We are not accepting resumes from recruiters for this position. Remuneration for recruiting activities is only applicable subject to a signed and executed agreement between the parties. Please don’t send candidates to Ayar Labs, and do not contact our managers.

**About Ayar Labs**
-------------------

At Ayar Labs we’re about to revolutionize computing by moving data with light. We’re unleashing processing power for artificial intelligence, high performance computing, cloud and telecommunications by removing the bottlenecks created by today’s electrical I/O - making it possible to continue scaling computing system performance. Ayar Labs is the first to deliver an optical I/O solution that combines in-package optical I/O chiplets and multi-wavelength remote light sources to replace traditional electrical I/O. This silicon photonics-based I/O solution enables chips to communicate with each other from millimeters to kilometers, to deliver orders of magnitude improvements in latency, bandwidth density, and power consumption.

With our strong collaborations with industry leaders and government, our deep ties to MIT and UC Berkeley, and our commitment to hiring the best engineers in photonics and electronics, joining our team gives you the opportunity to collaborate with renowned experts on challenging, paradigm-shifting work.

We are passionate about delivering in-package optical I/O at scale, leveraging the strength of our patent portfolio and our team of leading interdisciplinary experts. We believe that deep cross-collaboration between teams facilitated by honest, open debate is the best way to drive innovation and achieve big wins. Join our team and experience the possibilities.

**Keep the Co-Founder's day and the company's pipeline moving.**

Excellent Publicity is a media and advertising company. Since 2011 we have planned and bought media for 5,000+ brands, including the likes of Google, RBI, IIM-A, Amazon, Uber and Apple, across 3,00,000+ campaigns spanning hoardings, airports, metro and transit, newspapers, radio, cinema, television, digital, performance, influencer and sports.

**About the role:**

This is not a conventional administrative role. It sits beside the Co-Founder and runs the things he should not have to run himself.

You manage his meetings, reminders and day-to-day tasks, and you take over everything that does not genuinely need him in the room. **If a task can be done by you or got done through someone else, it should never reach him.**

The same ownership runs through the commercial side of the role. You make sure every enquiry the marketing team generates is actually worked, you follow the sales team through the full cycle until a deal closes or dies, and you build the dashboard that tells the Co-Founder what is happening without him having to ask anyone.

**You will not carry a sales target.** You will make sure nothing anywhere in the system is left unattended, unanswered or unexplained.

**What you will do:**

* **Run his calendar and his day.** Set up meetings, manage the schedule, keep reminders running and make sure he walks into every meeting prepared.
* **Take work off his desk.** Pick up the tasks that do not need him personally, do them yourself or get them done through the right person, and close them out without going back to him.
* **Carry his tasks into the teams.** Pass on instructions to sales, media, marketing, finance and tech, take a committed date and time from each person, record it and follow up until it is finished.
* **Make sure no enquiry is wasted.** Track every lead and enquiry the marketing team generates, make sure it is handed over to sales cleanly, and make sure someone has actually picked it up.
* **Follow the full cycle to closure.** Chase the sales team on pending leads and commitments, follow each enquiry end to end until the deal is closed or lost, and find out why the ones that do not convert are not converting.
* **Keep the CRM honest.** Keep lead status, follow-ups, conversions and pending actions accurate and current, and hold the sales team to updating it properly.
* **Build the dashboard.** Maintain the sales, CRM and management reporting the Co-Founder reads to know where things stand, and flag the gaps and pending actions rather than simply presenting numbers.

**1st - 3rd Week:** Learn the organisation chart, the sales process and the CRM as it stands. Take over the Co-Founder's calendar and task list and start running the daily follow-up cycle.

**4th - 8th Week:** Clean up and take ownership of the CRM. Establish the weekly rhythm with the sales team and deliver the first management report with gaps flagged.

**9th - 12th Week**: Run it without supervision: the Co-Founder's day moves on your tracking, and the dashboard tells him where every enquiry stands.

* **Follow-through is the skill we will not compromise on.** If you are the person who remembers every pending item, chases it without being reminded and closes it out, we can teach you the rest of this role.
* **Mature, dependable and execution-oriented.** You own what you are given from the moment you are given it, and you come back with the status before you are asked for it.
* **Strong coordination and follow-up ability.** You keep a growing list of open items across many people, carry it from day to day, and nothing quietly disappears off it.
* **Able to get work done through other people,** and confident following up with both junior and senior colleagues, politely, persistently and without taking a pushback personally.
* **Fluent English and Hindi, written and spoken,** with the interpersonal skills to work with every function in the company.
* **A good working understanding of CRM, lead management and sales processes,** and the judgement to see when a number on a report does not reflect what is actually happening.
* **Strong at reporting, organised and discreet.** Comfortable in Excel, able to turn messy pipeline data into a clear dashboard, and trustworthy with confidential business information.

The Vendor Management team supports the effective management and operation of our external vendor ecosystem. We work globally, across internal teams, vendors and key stakeholders to ensure vendor engagements are established, onboarded and managed effectively, with the right processes, governance, data and controls in place.


Our responsibilities span the vendor lifecycle and include onboarding and offboarding, operational governance, stakeholder and vendor coordination, process management, reporting and analytics, data quality, tooling and continuous improvement.


We are looking for a proactive and technically capable **Operations Analyst** to join the team in India. This role will combine day\-to\-day vendor management and onboarding support with ownership of operational tooling, reporting and process automation. The successful candidate will be comfortable and proficient working with data and systems as well as engaging with stakeholders and vendors to drive activities through to completion.


**Key Responsibilities**


The successful candidate will:


* Support end\-to\-end vendor and resource onboarding, offboarding and lifecycle activities, coordinating across vendors and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate completion.
* Act as a key operational contact for vendors and stakeholders, managing queries, resolving issues and proactively following up on outstanding actions.
* Maintain and enhance Jira boards, workflows, dashboards and reporting to support effective management of vendor activities.
* Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reporting to provide clear visibility of operational performance, trends, risks and actions.
* Build and maintain Power Automate workflows to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort and strengthen operational processes and controls.
* Maintain accurate vendor and operational data, supporting regular and ad\-hoc reporting, governance and stakeholder reviews.
* Identify and implement opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate processes, maintaining clear process documentation and user guidance.
* Provide flexible operational and technical support across the Vendor Management and Engineering Operations teams, collaborating with colleagues to deliver team priorities.

**The Successful Candidate is/has:**


* Proficiency in Jira and Microsoft, particularly Power BI and Power Automate, with hands\-on experience building and maintaining workflows, dashboards, reporting and automation.
* Experience supporting vendor management, onboarding, operations or business processes within a corporate environment.
* Strong analytical and technical skills, with excellent attention to detail and confidence working with data and multiple systems.
* A proactive, process\-oriented mindset with strong problem\-solving and continuous improvement capabilities.
* Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, take ownership and drive activities through to completion.
* Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with both internal stakeholders and external vendors.
* A collaborative and adaptable approach, with the ability to work independently as part of a geographically distributed team.

**Desirable Experience**


* Previous experience within a Vendor Management, Procurement, Operations, PMO or Service Management environment.
* Experience supporting onboarding or lifecycle management of external/vendor resources.
* Understanding of operational governance, controls and data management.
* Experience working with global stakeholders and teams across different time zones.

**Hybrid Working at Arm**
-------------------------


Arm’s approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team’s needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you.
